verses.original: ה֥וֹי הַחֹֽקְקִ֖ים חִקְקֵי־ אָ֑וֶן וּֽמְכַתְּבִ֥ים עָמָ֖ל כִּתֵּֽבוּ׃
verses.transliteration: hō·w ha·ḥō·qə·qîm ḥiq·qê- ’ā·wen ū·mə·ḵat·tə·ḇîm ‘ā·māl kit·tê·ḇū
verses.literal: Woe to those who enact unjust statutes and issue oppressive decrees

verses.original: לְהַטּ֤וֹת מִדִּין֙ דַּלִּ֔ים וְלִגְזֹ֕ל מִשְׁפַּ֖ט עֲנִיֵּ֣י עַמִּ֑י לִהְי֤וֹת אַלְמָנוֹת֙ שְׁלָלָ֔ם וְאֶת־ יְתוֹמִ֖ים יָבֹֽזּוּ׃
verses.transliteration: lə·haṭ·ṭō·wṯ mid·dîn dal·lîm wə·liḡ·zōl miš·paṭ ‘ă·nî·yê ‘am·mî lih·yō·wṯ ’al·mā·nō·wṯ šə·lā·lām wə·’eṯ- yə·ṯō·w·mîm yā·ḇōz·zū
verses.literal: to deprive the poor of fair treatment and withhold justice from the oppressed of My people to make widows their prey and orphans their plunder

verses.original: וּמַֽה־ תַּעֲשׂוּ֙ לְי֣וֹם פְּקֻדָּ֔ה וּלְשׁוֹאָ֖ה מִמֶּרְחָ֣ק תָּב֑וֹא עַל־ מִי֙ תָּנ֣וּסוּ לְעֶזְרָ֔ה וְאָ֥נָה תַעַזְב֖וּ כְּבוֹדְכֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: ū·mah- ta·‘ă·śū lə·yō·wm pə·qud·dāh ū·lə·šō·w·’āh mim·mer·ḥāq tā·ḇō·w ‘al- mî tā·nū·sū lə·‘ez·rāh wə·’ā·nāh ṯa·‘az·ḇū kə·ḇō·wḏ·ḵem
verses.literal: What will you do on the day of reckoning when devastation comes from afar To whom will you flee for help Where will you leave your wealth

verses.original: בִּלְתִּ֤י כָרַע֙ תַּ֣חַת אַסִּ֔יר וְתַ֥חַת הֲרוּגִ֖ים יִפֹּ֑לוּ בְּכָל־ זֹאת֙ לֹא־ שָׁ֣ב אַפּ֔וֹ וְע֖וֹד יָד֥וֹ נְטוּיָֽה׃ס
verses.transliteration: bil·tî ḵā·ra‘ ta·ḥaṯ ’as·sîr wə·ṯa·ḥaṯ hă·rū·ḡîm yip·pō·lū bə·ḵāl zōṯ lō- šāḇ ’ap·pōw wə·‘ō·wḏ yā·ḏōw nə·ṭū·yāh
verses.literal: Nothing will remain but to crouch among the captives or fall among the slain Despite all this His anger is not turned away His hand is still upraised

verses.original: ה֥וֹי אַשּׁ֖וּר שֵׁ֣בֶט אַפִּ֑י וּמַטֶּה־ ה֥וּא בְיָדָ֖ם זַעְמִֽי׃
verses.transliteration: hō·w ’aš·šūr šê·ḇeṭ ’ap·pî ū·maṭ·ṭeh- hū ḇə·yā·ḏām za‘·mî
verses.literal: Woe to Assyria the rod of My anger the staff . . . in their hands is My wrath

verses.original: בְּג֤וֹי חָנֵף֙ אֲשַׁלְּחֶ֔נּוּ וְעַל־ עַ֥ם עֶבְרָתִ֖י אֲצַוֶּ֑נּוּ לִשְׁלֹ֤ל שָׁלָל֙ וְלָבֹ֣ז בַּ֔ז וּלְשִׂימוֹ מִרְמָ֖ס כְּחֹ֥מֶר חוּצֽוֹת׃
verses.transliteration: bə·ḡō·w ḥā·nêp̄ ’ă·šal·lə·ḥen·nū wə·‘al- ‘am ‘eḇ·rā·ṯî ’ă·ṣaw·wen·nū liš·lōl šā·lāl wə·lā·ḇōz baz ū·lə·śī·mō mir·mās kə·ḥō·mer ḥū·ṣō·wṯ
verses.literal: I will send him against a godless nation I will dispatch him against a people destined for My rage to take spoils and seize plunder and to trample them down . . . like clay in the streets

verses.original: וְהוּא֙ לֹא־ כֵ֣ן יְדַמֶּ֔ה וּלְבָב֖וֹ לֹא־ כֵ֣ן יַחְשֹׁ֑ב כִּ֚י לְהַשְׁמִ֣יד בִּלְבָב֔וֹ וּלְהַכְרִ֥ית גּוֹיִ֖ם לֹ֥א מְעָֽט׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hū lō- ḵên yə·ḏam·meh ū·lə·ḇā·ḇōw lō- ḵên yaḥ·šōḇ kî lə·haš·mîḏ bil·ḇā·ḇōw ū·lə·haḵ·rîṯ gō·w·yim lō mə·‘āṭ
verses.literal: But this is not his intention this is not his plan . . . . . . For it is in his heart to destroy and cut off many . . . nations

verses.original: כִּ֖י יֹאמַ֑ר הֲלֹ֥א שָׂרַ֛י יַחְדָּ֖ו מְלָכִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: kî yō·mar hă·lō śā·ray yaḥ·dāw mə·lā·ḵîm
verses.literal: Are not all my commanders kings he says

verses.original: הֲלֹ֥א כְּכַרְכְּמִ֖ישׁ כַּלְנ֑וֹ אִם־ לֹ֤א כְאַרְפַּד֙ חֲמָ֔ת אִם־ לֹ֥א כְדַמֶּ֖שֶׂק שֹׁמְרֽוֹן׃
verses.transliteration: hă·lō kə·ḵar·kə·mîš kal·nōw ’im- lō ḵə·’ar·paḏ ḥă·māṯ ’im- lō ḵə·ḏam·me·śeq šō·mə·rō·wn
verses.literal: Is not Calno . . . like Carchemish Is not Hamath . . . like Arpad Is not Samaria like Damascus

verses.original: כַּאֲשֶׁר֙ מָצְאָ֣ה יָדִ֔י לְמַמְלְכֹ֖ת הָאֱלִ֑יל וּפְסִ֣ילֵיהֶ֔ם מִירֽוּשָׁלִַ֖ם וּמִשֹּׁמְרֽוֹן׃
verses.transliteration: ka·’ă·šer mā·ṣə·’āh yā·ḏî lə·mam·lə·ḵōṯ hā·’ĕ·lîl ū·p̄ə·sî·lê·hem mî·rū·šā·lim ū·miš·šō·mə·rō·wn
verses.literal: As my hand seized the idolatrous kingdoms whose images surpassed those of Jerusalem and Samaria

verses.original: הֲלֹ֗א כַּאֲשֶׁ֥ר עָשִׂ֛יתִי לְשֹׁמְר֖וֹן וְלֶאֱלִילֶ֑יהָ כֵּ֛ן אֶעֱשֶׂ֥ה לִירוּשָׁלִַ֖ם וְלַעֲצַבֶּֽיהָ׃ס
verses.transliteration: hă·lō ka·’ă·šer ‘ā·śî·ṯî lə·šō·mə·rō·wn wə·le·’ĕ·lî·le·hā kên ’e·‘ĕ·śeh lî·rū·šā·lim wə·la·‘ă·ṣab·be·hā
verses.literal: and as I have done to Samaria and its idols will I not also do to Jerusalem and her idols

verses.original: וְהָיָ֗ה כִּֽי־ יְבַצַּ֤ע אֲדֹנָי֙ אֶת־ כָּל־ מַֽעֲשֵׂ֔הוּ בְּהַ֥ר צִיּ֖וֹן וּבִירוּשָׁלִָ֑ם אֶפְקֹ֗ד עַל־ פְּרִי־ גֹ֙דֶל֙ לְבַ֣ב מֶֽלֶךְ־ אַשּׁ֔וּר וְעַל־ תִּפְאֶ֖רֶת ר֥וּם עֵינָֽיו׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hā·yāh kî- yə·ḇaṣ·ṣa‘ ’ă·ḏō·nāy ’eṯ- kāl- ma·‘ă·śê·hū bə·har ṣî·yō·wn ū·ḇî·rū·šā·lim ’ep̄·qōḏ ‘al- pə·rî- ḡō·ḏel lə·ḇaḇ me·leḵ- ’aš·šūr wə·‘al- tip̄·’e·reṯ rūm ‘ê·nāw
verses.literal: So when the Lord has completed all His work against Mount Zion and Jerusalem He will say, “I will punish the king of Assyria . . . . . . for the fruit of his arrogant heart and the proud look in his eyes

verses.original: כִּ֣י אָמַ֗ר בְּכֹ֤חַ יָדִי֙ עָשִׂ֔יתִי וּבְחָכְמָתִ֖י כִּ֣י נְבֻנ֑וֹתִי וְאָסִ֣יר׀ גְּבוּלֹ֣ת עַמִּ֗ים וַעֲתִידֹתֵיהֶם שׁוֹשֵׂ֔תִי וְאוֹרִ֥יד כַּאבִּ֖יר יוֹשְׁבִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: kî ’ā·mar bə·ḵō·aḥ yā·ḏî ‘ā·śî·ṯî ū·ḇə·ḥā·ḵə·mā·ṯî kî nə·ḇu·nō·w·ṯî wə·’ā·sîr gə·ḇū·lōṯ ‘am·mîm wa·ʿă·ṯī·ḏō·ṯē·hɛm šō·w·śê·ṯî wə·’ō·w·rîḏ ka·bîr yō·wō·šə·ḇîm
verses.literal: For he says By the strength of my hand I have done this and by my wisdom for I am clever I have removed the boundaries of nations and plundered their treasures like a mighty one I subdued their rulers

verses.original: וַתִּמְצָ֨א כַקֵּ֤ן׀ יָדִי֙ לְחֵ֣יל הָֽעַמִּ֔ים וְכֶאֱסֹף֙ בֵּיצִ֣ים עֲזֻב֔וֹת כָּל־ הָאָ֖רֶץ אֲנִ֣י אָסָ֑פְתִּי וְלֹ֤א הָיָה֙ נֹדֵ֣ד כָּנָ֔ף וּפֹצֶ֥ה פֶ֖ה וּמְצַפְצֵֽף׃
verses.transliteration: wat·tim·ṣā ḵaq·qên yā·ḏî lə·ḥêl hā·‘am·mîm wə·ḵe·’ĕ·sōp̄ bê·ṣîm ‘ă·zu·ḇō·wṯ kāl- hā·’ā·reṣ ’ă·nî ’ā·sā·p̄ə·tî wə·lō hā·yāh nō·ḏêḏ kā·nāp̄ ū·p̄ō·ṣeh p̄eh ū·mə·ṣap̄·ṣêp̄
verses.literal: My hand reached as into a nest to seize the wealth of the nations Like one gathering abandoned eggs I gathered all the earth No . . . wing fluttered no beak opened or chirped

verses.original: הֲיִתְפָּאֵר֙ הַגַּרְזֶ֔ן עַ֖ל הַחֹצֵ֣ב בּ֑וֹ אִם־ יִתְגַּדֵּ֤ל הַמַּשּׂוֹר֙ עַל־ מְנִיפ֔וֹ כְּהָנִ֥יף שֵׁ֙בֶט֙ וְאֶת־ מְרִימָ֔יו כְּהָרִ֥ים מַטֶּ֖ה לֹא־ עֵֽץ׃
verses.transliteration: hă·yiṯ·pā·’êr hag·gar·zen ‘al ha·ḥō·ṣêḇ bōw ’im- yiṯ·gad·dêl ham·maś·śō·wr ‘al- mə·nî·p̄ōw kə·hā·nîp̄ šê·ḇeṭ wə·’eṯ- mə·rî·māw kə·hā·rîm maṭ·ṭeh lō- ‘êṣ
verses.literal: Does an axe raise itself above the one who swings it Does a saw boast over him who saws with it? It would be like a rod waving the one who lifts it or a staff lifting him who is not wood

verses.original: לָ֠כֵן יְשַׁלַּ֨ח הָאָד֜וֹן יְהוָ֧ה צְבָא֛וֹת בְּמִשְׁמַנָּ֖יו רָז֑וֹן וְתַ֧חַת כְּבֹד֛וֹ יֵקַ֥ד יְקֹ֖ד כִּיק֥וֹד אֵֽשׁ׃
verses.transliteration: lā·ḵên yə·šal·laḥ hā·’ā·ḏō·wn Yah·weh ṣə·ḇā·’ō·wṯ bə·miš·man·nāw rā·zō·wn wə·ṯa·ḥaṯ kə·ḇō·ḏōw yê·qaḏ yə·qōḏ kî·qō·wḏ ’êš
verses.literal: Therefore the Lord GOD of Hosts will send a wasting disease among Assyria’s stout warriors and under his pomp will be kindled a fire like a burning flame

verses.original: וְהָיָ֤ה אֽוֹר־ יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ לְאֵ֔שׁ וּקְדוֹשׁ֖וֹ לְלֶהָבָ֑ה וּבָעֲרָ֗ה וְאָֽכְלָ֛ה שִׁית֥וֹ וּשְׁמִיר֖וֹ בְּי֥וֹם אֶחָֽד׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hā·yāh ’ō·wr- yiś·rā·’êl lə·’êš ū·qə·ḏō·wō·šōw lə·le·hā·ḇāh ū·ḇā·‘ă·rāh wə·’ā·ḵə·lāh šî·ṯōw ū·šə·mî·rōw bə·yō·wm ’e·ḥāḏ
verses.literal: And the Light of Israel will become a fire and its Holy One a flame In a single day it will burn and devour Assyria’s thorns and thistles

verses.original: וּכְב֤וֹד יַעְרוֹ֙ וְכַרְמִלּ֔וֹ מִנֶּ֥פֶשׁ וְעַד־ בָּשָׂ֖ר יְכַלֶּ֑ה וְהָיָ֖ה כִּמְסֹ֥ס נֹסֵֽס׃
verses.transliteration: ū·ḵə·ḇō·wḏ ya‘·rōw wə·ḵar·mil·lōw min·ne·p̄eš wə·‘aḏ- bā·śār yə·ḵal·leh wə·hā·yāh kim·sōs nō·sês
verses.literal: The splendor of its forests and orchards both soul and body it will completely destroy . . . as a sickness consumes a man . . .

verses.original: וּשְׁאָ֥ר עֵ֛ץ יַעְר֖וֹ מִסְפָּ֣ר יִֽהְי֑וּ וְנַ֖עַר יִכְתְּבֵֽם׃פ
verses.transliteration: ū·šə·’ār ‘êṣ ya‘·rōw mis·pār yih·yū wə·na·‘ar yiḵ·tə·ḇêm
verses.literal: The remaining trees of its forests will be so few that a child could count them

verses.original: וְהָיָ֣ה׀ בַּיּ֣וֹם הַה֗וּא לֹֽא־ יוֹסִ֨יף ע֜וֹד שְׁאָ֤ר יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ וּפְלֵיטַ֣ת בֵּֽית־ יַעֲקֹ֔ב לְהִשָּׁעֵ֖ן עַל־ מַכֵּ֑הוּ וְנִשְׁעַ֗ן עַל־ יְהוָ֛ה קְד֥וֹשׁ יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל בֶּאֱמֶֽת׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hā·yāh bay·yō·wm ha·hū lō- yō·w·sîp̄ ‘ō·wḏ šə·’ār yiś·rā·’êl ū·p̄ə·lê·ṭaṯ bêṯ- ya·‘ă·qōḇ lə·hiš·šā·‘ên ‘al- mak·kê·hū wə·niš·‘an ‘al- Yah·weh qə·ḏō·wōš yiś·rā·’êl be·’ĕ·meṯ
verses.literal: On that day the remnant of Israel and the survivors of the house of Jacob will no longer . . . depend on him who struck them but they will truly rely on the LORD the Holy One of Israel

verses.original: שְׁאָ֥ר יָשׁ֖וּב שְׁאָ֣ר יַעֲקֹ֑ב אֶל־ אֵ֖ל גִּבּֽוֹר׃
verses.transliteration: šə·’ār yā·šūḇ šə·’ār ya·‘ă·qōḇ ’el- ’êl gib·bō·wr
verses.literal: A remnant will return a remnant of Jacob to the Mighty God

verses.original: כִּ֣י אִם־ יִהְיֶ֞ה עַמְּךָ֤ יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ כְּח֣וֹל הַיָּ֔ם שְׁאָ֖ר יָשׁ֣וּב בּ֑וֹ כִּלָּי֥וֹן חָר֖וּץ שׁוֹטֵ֥ף צְדָקָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: kî ’im- yih·yeh ‘am·mə·ḵā yiś·rā·’êl kə·ḥō·wl hay·yām šə·’ār yā·šūḇ bōw kil·lā·yō·wn ḥā·rūṣ šō·w·ṭêp̄ ṣə·ḏā·qāh
verses.literal: Though . . . your people O Israel be like the sand of the sea only a remnant will return Destruction has been decreed overflowing with righteousness

verses.original: כִּ֥י כָלָ֖ה וְנֶחֱרָצָ֑ה אֲדֹנָ֤י יְהוִה֙ צְבָא֔וֹת עֹשֶׂ֖ה בְּקֶ֥רֶב כָּל־ הָאָֽרֶץ׃ס
verses.transliteration: kî ḵā·lāh wə·ne·ḥĕ·rā·ṣāh ’ă·ḏō·nāy Yah·weh ṣə·ḇā·’ō·wṯ ‘ō·śeh bə·qe·reḇ kāl- hā·’ā·reṣ
verses.literal: For the Lord GOD of Hosts will carry out the destruction decreed upon the whole land

verses.original: לָכֵ֗ן כֹּֽה־ אָמַ֞ר אֲדֹנָ֤י יְהוִה֙ צְבָא֔וֹת אַל־ תִּירָ֥א עַמִּ֛י יֹשֵׁ֥ב צִיּ֖וֹן מֵֽאַשּׁ֑וּר בַּשֵּׁ֣בֶט יַכֶּ֔כָּה וּמַטֵּ֥הוּ יִשָּֽׂא־ עָלֶ֖יךָ בְּדֶ֥רֶךְ מִצְרָֽיִם׃
verses.transliteration: lā·ḵên kōh- ’ā·mar ’ă·ḏō·nāy Yah·weh ṣə·ḇā·’ō·wṯ ’al- tî·rā ‘am·mî yō·šêḇ ṣî·yō·wn mê·’aš·šūr baš·šê·ḇeṭ yak·kek·kāh ū·maṭ·ṭê·hū yiś·śā- ‘ā·le·ḵā bə·ḏe·reḵ miṣ·rā·yim
verses.literal: Therefore this is what the Lord GOD of Hosts says O My people who dwell in Zion do not fear Assyria who strikes you with a rod and lifts his staff against you as the Egyptians did

verses.original: כִּי־ ע֖וֹד מְעַ֣ט מִזְעָ֑ר וְכָ֣לָה זַ֔עַם וְאַפִּ֖י עַל־ תַּבְלִיתָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: kî- ‘ō·wḏ mə·‘aṭ miz·‘ār wə·ḵā·lāh za·‘am wə·’ap·pî ‘al- taḇ·lî·ṯām
verses.literal: For in just a little while . . . My fury against you will subside and My anger will turn to their destruction

verses.original: וְעוֹרֵ֨ר עָלָ֜יו יְהוָ֤ה צְבָאוֹת֙ שׁ֔וֹט כְּמַכַּ֥ת מִדְיָ֖ן בְּצ֣וּר עוֹרֵ֑ב וּמַטֵּ֙הוּ֙ עַל־ הַיָּ֔ם וּנְשָׂא֖וֹ בְּדֶ֥רֶךְ מִצְרָֽיִם׃
verses.transliteration: wə·‘ō·w·rêr ‘ā·lāw Yah·weh ṣə·ḇā·’ō·wṯ šō·wṭ kə·mak·kaṯ miḏ·yān bə·ṣūr ‘ō·w·rêḇ ū·maṭ·ṭê·hū ‘al- hay·yām ū·nə·śā·’ōw bə·ḏe·reḵ miṣ·rā·yim
verses.literal: And the LORD of Hosts will brandish a whip against them as when He struck Midian at the rock of Oreb He will raise . . . His staff over the sea as He did in Egypt

verses.original: וְהָיָ֣ה׀ בַּיּ֣וֹם הַה֗וּא יָס֤וּר סֻבֳּלוֹ֙ מֵעַ֣ל שִׁכְמֶ֔ךָ וְעֻלּ֖וֹ מֵעַ֣ל צַוָּארֶ֑ךָ וְחֻבַּ֥ל עֹ֖ל מִפְּנֵי־ שָֽׁמֶן׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hā·yāh bay·yō·wm ha·hū yā·sūr sub·bo·lōw mê·‘al šiḵ·me·ḵā wə·‘ul·lōw mê·‘al ṣaw·wā·re·ḵā wə·ḥub·bal ‘ōl mip·pə·nê- šā·men
verses.literal: On that day the burden will be lifted from your shoulders and the yoke from your neck The yoke will be broken because your neck will be too large

verses.original: בָּ֥א עַל־ עַיַּ֖ת עָבַ֣ר בְּמִגְר֑וֹן לְמִכְמָ֖שׂ יַפְקִ֥יד כֵּלָֽיו׃
verses.transliteration: bā ‘al- ‘ay·yaṯ ‘ā·ḇar bə·miḡ·rō·wn lə·miḵ·māś yap̄·qîḏ kê·lāw
verses.literal: Assyria has entered . . . Aiath and passed through Migron storing their supplies at Michmash

verses.original: עָֽבְרוּ֙ מַעְבָּרָ֔ה גֶּ֖בַע מָל֣וֹן לָ֑נוּ חָֽרְדָה֙ הָֽרָמָ֔ה גִּבְעַ֥ת שָׁא֖וּל נָֽסָה׃
verses.transliteration: ‘ā·ḇə·rū ma‘·bā·rāh ge·ḇa‘ mā·lō·wn lā·nū ḥā·rə·ḏāh hā·rā·māh giḇ·‘aṯ šā·’ūl nā·sāh
verses.literal: They have crossed at the ford We will spend the night at Geba Ramah trembles Gibeah of Saul flees

verses.original: צַהֲלִ֥י קוֹלֵ֖ךְ בַּת־ גַּלִּ֑ים הַקְשִׁ֥יבִי לַ֖יְשָׁה עֲנִיָּ֥ה עֲנָתֽוֹת׃
verses.transliteration: ṣa·hă·lî qō·w·lêḵ baṯ- gal·lîm haq·šî·ḇî lay·šāh ‘ă·nî·yāh ‘ă·nā·ṯō·wṯ
verses.literal: Cry aloud . . . O Daughter of Gallim Listen O Laishah O wretched Anathoth

verses.original: נָדְדָ֖ה מַדְמֵנָ֑ה יֹשְׁבֵ֥י הַגֵּבִ֖ים הֵעִֽיזוּ׃
verses.transliteration: nā·ḏə·ḏāh maḏ·mê·nāh yō·šə·ḇê hag·gê·ḇîm hê·‘î·zū
verses.literal: Madmenah flees the people of Gebim take refuge

verses.original: ע֥וֹד הַיּ֖וֹם בְּנֹ֣ב לַֽעֲמֹ֑ד יְנֹפֵ֤ף יָדוֹ֙ הַ֣ר בֵּית צִיּ֔וֹן גִּבְעַ֖ת יְרוּשָׁלִָֽם׃ס
verses.transliteration: ‘ō·wḏ hay·yō·wm bə·nōḇ la·‘ă·mōḏ yə·nō·p̄êp̄ yā·ḏōw har bēṯ ṣî·yō·wn giḇ·‘aṯ yə·rū·šā·lim
verses.literal: Yet today they will halt at Nob shaking a fist at the mount of Daughter Zion at the hill of Jerusalem

verses.original: הִנֵּ֤ה הָאָדוֹן֙ יְהוָ֣ה צְבָא֔וֹת מְסָעֵ֥ף פֻּארָ֖ה בְּמַעֲרָצָ֑ה וְרָמֵ֤י הַקּוֹמָה֙ גְּדוּעִ֔ים וְהַגְּבֹהִ֖ים יִשְׁפָּֽלוּ׃
verses.transliteration: hin·nêh hā·’ā·ḏō·wn Yah·weh ṣə·ḇā·’ō·wṯ mə·sā·‘êp̄ pu·rāh bə·ma·‘ă·rā·ṣāh wə·rā·mê haq·qō·w·māh gə·ḏū·‘îm wə·hag·gə·ḇō·hîm yiš·pā·lū
verses.literal: Behold the Lord GOD of Hosts will lop off the branches with terrifying power The tall trees will be cut down the lofty ones will be felled

verses.original: וְנִקַּ֛ף סִֽבְכֵ֥י הַיַּ֖עַר בַּבַּרְזֶ֑ל וְהַלְּבָנ֖וֹן בְּאַדִּ֥יר יִפּֽוֹל׃ס
verses.transliteration: wə·niq·qap̄ siḇ·ḵê hay·ya·‘ar bab·bar·zel wə·hal·lə·ḇā·nō·wn bə·’ad·dîr yip·pō·wl
verses.literal: He will clear the forest thickets with an axe and Lebanon will fall before the Mighty One
